**Newsroom brief: SINGLE-SOURCE REPORT - REUTERS | Reuters reports gold below $4,000: a test for the safe-haven story [Source 2026-10-23]**

SINGLE-SOURCE REPORT - REUTERS: gold below $4,000 and declines in silver, platinum and palladium complicate a simple safe-haven story.

**Context:** Reuters attributed the pressure to higher energy prices, inflation concerns and expectations of a US rate increase ahead of the following week's Federal Reserve meeting.

Read the article: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/pending-publication-252873df545bc899

Source date: 2026-10-23. Interpretation remains analysis.
